CustomField.description: The Partner/Provider Code for this Partner. This is the code entered in Dashboard. The Admin Integration automatically adds the Partner Code to the Product Config record. An automation will be built to auto link the Prod Config to the Partner Account with the associated Partner Code.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the Partner/Provider Code used in Dashboard so this Partner Record can be linked to Product Config Records with this code.
CustomField.label: Partner Code
